name: @batonos/cli
description: Manage your own agent network: nodes, capabilities, and the safety gate in front of them.

scripts.build: { rm -rf dist/templates.new dist/plugins.new && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/bin/baton.js && cp -r ../templates dist/templates.new && cp -r ../providers dist/plugins.new && rm -rf dist/templates && mv dist/templates.new dist/templates && rm -rf dist/plugins && mv dist/plugins.new dist/plugins && ../scripts/source-stamp.sh > dist/.source; } || { rc=$?; rm -rf dist/templates.new dist/plugins.new; rm -f dist/.source; exit $rc; }
